title: Multi-line connector labels
description: Support intentional line breaks in graph and metadata connector labels with collision-aware SVG sizing.
completion_criteria: Graph connector labels accept an escaped newline without changing the line-oriented graph grammar.
Metadata connector labels preserve real YAML newlines.
SVG connector labels render one centered tspan per visual line.
Connector label backgrounds fit the longest line and complete line stack.
Collision geometry reserves the same multiline bounds that SVG renders.
Syntax and AI authoring guidance document the contract.
Targeted tests, typecheck, and production build pass.
success_criteria: Authors can split long connector descriptions without fixed coordinates or manual dimensions.
Multi-line connector labels remain associated with their routed edge and reserve readable clearance.
Existing single-line labels and compact semantic overlay badges remain compatible.
triage_notes: Automatic wrapping and multi-line semantic overlay badges remain out of scope; authors explicitly choose ordinary connector-label line breaks.
